{{AnimePokémonInfobox| type1=Psychic| type2=Flying| trainername=Jessie| pokemonname=Woobat| jtrainername=ムサシ| jpokemonname=コロモリ| tmtrainername=Musashi| tmpokemonname=Koromori| image=[[File:Jessie Woobat.png|250px]] | caption=Jessie's Woobat| ability=Unknown| gender=MaleConfirmed in ''[[BW139|Team Rocket's Shocking Recruit!]]''.| prevonum=527| location={{rt|1|Unova}} | epnum=BW002| epname=Enter Iris and Axew!| current=[[Party|With Jessie]]| enva1=[[Michele Knotz]]| java1=[[Kiyotaka Furushima]]| }} '''Jessie's Woobat''' (Japanese: '''ムサシのコロモリ''' ''Musashi's Koromori'') is the first Pokémon that [[Jessie]] {{pkmn2|caught}} in the [[Unova]] [[region]], and her eighth overall. ==History== ==={{aniseries|BW}}=== ====Unova==== [[File:Ash Pidove vs Jessie Woobat.png|250px|thumb|left|Woobat battling Pidove]] In ''[[BW002|Enter Iris and Axew!]]'', while in a cave planning their move, the [[Team Rocket trio]] saw a group of {{p|Woobat}}. Jessie caught one off-screen, as was revealed when Jessie called him out to battle {{Ash}}'s newly acquired {{AP|Pidove}}. He was able to defeat the {{pkmn|category|Tiny Pigeon Pokémon}} with a single Gust as she was already weakened during her battle with {{AP|Pikachu}}. He was then defeated by {{AP|Oshawott}}'s {{m|Water Gun}} after he had worn {{AP|Pikachu}} and {{TP|Iris|Axew}} out. In ''[[BW026|Scare at the Litwick Mansion!]]'', Woobat teamed up with [[James's Yamask]], Ash's Oshawott, Ash's Pikachu, and [[Cilan's Dwebble]] to defeat the {{p|Litwick}} and their {{p|Lampent}} leader. In ''[[BW075|A Restoration Confrontation! Part 1]]'', Woobat was used to capture a {{p|Tirtouga}} that [[Dr. Zager]] had just resurrected, however it escaped after blowing a hole in the helicopter with {{m|Ancient Power}}. In [[BW076|the next episode]], Woobat battled to capture the Prototurtle Pokémon alongside Yamask, until Tirtouga evolved into {{p|Carracosta}} and fled the scene. Woobat later battled {{AP|Pikachu}} and [[Cilan's Pansage]] as they tied to rescue the captured Carracosta before the time gate at [[Twist Mountain]]. [[File:Jessie Woobat James Yamask ambush.png|250px|thumb|Woobat and Yamask ambushing Ash in order to steal Meloetta]] Sometime before ''[[BW082|An Epic Defense Force!]]'', Team Rocket began tracking {{an|Meloetta}} for their latest plan, Operation Tempest. Woobat [[BW085|later]] teamed up with Yamask to expose the Melody Pokémon. {{MTR}} tried to catch it in an electric net but Meloetta escaped through its invisibility. In ''[[BW096|Meloetta and the Undersea Temple!]]'', Woobat and Yamask confronted Ash and his friends so that Team Rocket could steal Meloetta. He battled against [[Iris's Axew]] and Cilan's Pansage while {{an|Giovanni}} pursued Ash and Meloetta. Then in the [[BW097|next episode]], Woobat and Yamask used their combined attacks to launch Ash off the top of the ancient temple to prevent him from interfering with Operation Tempest. After the operation failed, Woobat joined Jessie in retreating to [[Kanto]]. When Jessie returned to Unova in ''[[BW109|New Places...Familiar Faces!]]'', she brought Woobat with her, as revealed in ''[[BW113|The Light of Floccesy Ranch!]]'', where he was blasted off by an {{p|Ampharos}} Team Rocket attempted to steal. In ''[[BW117|Team Plasma's Pokémon Manipulation!]]'', Woobat was used to battle [[Aldith]]'s {{p|Liepard}} alongside {{TP|James|Amoonguss}} as Jessie, [[James]], and Meowth tried to steal [[Colress]]'s Pokémon manipulation machine. Eventually Liepard's {{m|Shadow Ball}} veered and hit Colress's machine, releasing [[Iris's Dragonite]] and [[Rhoder]]'s {{p|Haxorus}} which were under his control. In ''[[BW122|What Lies Beyond Truth and Ideals!]]'', Woobat helped fight off [[Team Plasma]]'s controlled Pokémon. ====Decolore Islands==== In ''[[BW139|Team Rocket's Shocking Recruit!]]'', Woobat battled Ash and {{ashfr}} for the final time in {{aniseries|BW}}. Team Rocket had managed to trap Iris's Axew and {{TP|Iris|Emolga}}, and [[Ash's Snivy]] stepped up to save them. Woobat tried to stop her with Air Slash, but was pushed back by multiple {{m|Vine Whip}}s and a {{m|Leaf Storm}}. The Pokémon were then freed by a variety of attacks and Team Rocket was blasted off. Woobat was given away to {{an|Giovanni}} for Team Rocket in ''[[BW142|The Dream Continues!]]''. ==={{aniseries|JN}}=== In ''[[JN145|Rocket Revengers!]]'', Woobat, alongside the rest of Team Rocket's Pokémon at {{an|Team Rocket HQ}}, were sent to Jessie and James so they could be added back to their team. Realizing the potential of such a large group, the team hatched a scheme to isolate Ash's Pikachu and capture him. Woobat was one of the many Pokémon that waited at the end of the trap, where he ambushed an isolated Pikachu. When the rest of Team Rocket's Pokémon returned, Woobat joined them to launch a combined attack at the Mouse Pokémon. However, it was dodged, and {{TP|Jessie|Wobbuffet}} ended up sending it back with {{m|Mirror Coat}}. A wild {{an|Latias}} that had been following Ash then intervened and sent the evil group blasting off. ==Personality and characteristics== [[File:Jessie and Woobat.png|250px|thumb|left|Woobat and Jessie]] [[File:Jessie Woobat bullying Joltik.png|250px|thumb|Woobat bullying a Joltik]] Woobat has shown to have a personality like Jessie as shown in ''[[BW062|Crisis at Chargestone Cave!]]'', where Woobat was shown to like picking on Pokémon weaker and smaller than himself, shown when he was happy to chase and attack a small {{p|Joltik}}, but in ''[[BW037|A Fishy Connoisseur in a Fishy Competition!]]'', Woobat was weak and frightened when he was about to be hit by Pansage's {{m|Bullet Seed}} and when seeing Cilan's Dwebble evolve. {{-}} ==Moves used== {{anmov/h|psychic|flying|Jessie Woobat {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Gust|1=Air Slash|2=Hidden Power}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Gust|1=Air Slash|2=Hidden Power}}}} {{anmov|Flying|Air Slash|BW002|Enter Iris and Axew!}} {{anmov|Flying|Gust|BW002|Enter Iris and Axew!}} {{anmov|Normal|Hidden Power|BW115|The Pokémon Harbor Patrol!}} {{anmov/f|flying}} ===Moves improvised=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{psychic color}}; border: 3px solid #{{flying color dark}}; {{roundy}}" |- ! {{color|FFF|Picture}} ! {{color|FFF|First Used In}} ! {{color|FFF|Moves Involved}} ! {{color|FFF|Partnered With}} |- style="background:#FFF" | rowspan="2" | [[File:Team Rocket Combo Attack.png|150px]] | ''[[JN145|Rocket Revengers!]]'' | {{m|Air Slash}}, {{m|Shadow Ball}}, {{m|Energy Ball}}, {{m|Sludge Bomb}}, {{m|Psybeam}}, and {{m|Silver Wind}} | {{TP|Jessie|Seviper}}, {{TP|Jessie|Yanmega}}, {{TP|Jessie|Frillish}}, {{TP|Jessie|Gourgeist}}, {{TP|James|Carnivine}}, {{TP|James|Yamask}}, {{TP|James|Amoonguss}}, and {{TP|James|Inkay}} |- style="background:#FFF" | colspan="3" style="text-align:left" |'''Description:''' A combination move used by Jessie and James's Pokémon. Woobat launches Air Slash, Frillish, Gourgeist and Yamask launch Shadow Ball, Amoonguss and Carnivine launch Energy Ball, Yanmega launches Silver Wind, Inkay launches Psybeam, and Seviper launches Sludge Bomb. The attacks fuse together to create a single massive beam of energy. This was used against {{Ash}}, {{TP|Ash|Pikachu}}, {{TP|Ash|Infernape}}, and {{TP|Ash|Hawlucha}} in Team Rocket's attempt to steal Pikachu, but once they dodged, the attack headed towards Team Rocket. |} ==Artwork== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{flying color dark}}; background: #{{psychic color}}; font-size:80%;" |- | style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{flying color dark}}; background: #{{flying color light}}"| [[File:BW anime height chart.png|250px]] |- | Concept art from
